newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adel Brighton eyes 10 pct profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adel Brighton eyes 10 pct profit rise.

text.p: Cement maker Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Wednesday it hoped to achieve a 10 percent increase in net profit for the 1996/97 year ending June 30.

Asked if the company expected to continue the 10 percent improvement in profit for the year seen in first four months of 1996/97, chairman Rodney White said: "We are hoping to hold that result progressively through the year."
Adelaide Brighton posted net profit before abnormals of A$13.6 million in the year to June 30, 1996 and a net loss after abnormals of A$49.3 million.
White earlier told shareholders at the annual meeting the company was looking at raising A$100 million from previously announced asset sales over the next 18 months.
"I would be very disappointed if the total realisation of assets over an 18 month period did not knock A$100 million of debt off the balance sheet," he said.
White also told the meeting he intended to retire as chairman and as a director of Adelaide Brighton and annointed new director, Malcom Kinnaird as the new chairman.
"It is the board's intention to appoint Mr Kinnaird as chairman," he told reporters.
Kinnaird is currently executive chairman of Adelaide-based engineering group, Kinhill Ltd.
